label: Potion effects
on_description: the potion effects display is enabled
description: Active potion effects with amplifier and remaining duration.
settings_description: Settings for the Potion effects HUD mod. Reads `getActivePotionEffects`, pushed only when the set changes.

show_duration.description: Whether to print the remaining duration next to each effect.

show_amplifier.description: Whether to print the roman-numeral amplifier next to each effect name.

hide_ambient.description: Whether to omit ambient effects such as a beacon aura from the list.

hidden_effects.description: Effects never listed, as a bit mask over vanilla's status effect ids: bit 1 is Speed, bit 16 Night Vision, up to bit 23 Saturation. Set from the settings page's effect chips rather than by hand. 0 lists everything.

blink_below_s.description: An effect with this many seconds or fewer left blinks, once a second, on the tick that redraws its timer. 0 disables blinking.
